tc qdisc del dev eth0 root 2>/dev/null || true
tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 30
tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:1 htb rate 970mbit ceil 970mbit burst 64k quantum 1514
tc class add dev eth0 parent 1:1 classid 1:10 htb rate 200mbit ceil 970mbit prio 0 burst 64k quantum 1514
tc class add dev eth0 parent 1:1 classid 1:20 htb rate 100mbit ceil 970mbit prio 1 burst 64k quantum 1514
tc class add dev eth0 parent 1:1 classid 1:30 htb rate 1mbit ceil 970mbit prio 2 burst 64k quantum 1514
tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1:10 handle 10: fq_codel
tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1:20 handle 20: fq_codel
tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1:30 handle 30: fq_codel
tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol 802.1Q prio 1 flower vlan_ethtype ip ip_tos 0xc0 flowid 1:10
tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol 802.1Q prio 2 flower vlan_ethtype ip ip_tos 0x40 flowid 1:20
